## Setup
```{r}
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("Seurat")
library("rlist")
library("scDblFinder")
library("DoubletFinder")
library("parallel")
library("BiocParallel")
library("kableExtra")

source(
  file.path(file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
), "conf.R"))

path_project <- file.path(path_data, "cellranger_old")
l_samples <- list.files(path_project) %>%  
  .[sapply(., function(x) dir.exists(file.path(path_project, x)))]
n_cores <- detectCores() - 1
```

## Load data
```{r data}
list_seurat <- list.map(
    l_samples,
    f(x) ~{
      count_matrix <- file.path(path_project, x, "outs") %>% 
        list.files(full.names = TRUE) %>% 
        .[str_detect(., "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")]
      tmp <- Read10X_h5(count_matrix) %>%
      CreateSeuratObject() %>%
      set_percent()
    }
)
```

```{r}
cell_id <- paste0(str_extract(l_samples, "(WT)|(KO)"), "_", str_remove_all(l_samples, "(WT)|(KO)"))
seurat <- integrate_multisamples(list_seurat, cell_id)
```

## Filter cells with low or too high genes
```{r qc_plot, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_mqc(seurat, file = file.path(path_fig, "table_stats.png"))
```

```{r}
seurat_old <- seurat
list_seurat0 <- list_seurat
features <- c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent_mitochondrial")
list_seurat <- list.map(
    list_seurat,
    f(i) ~{
      stats_qc <- sapply(
        features,
        function(x) quantile(
            i[[x]], 
            probs = c(0, .025, .05, .1, seq(.25, .75, .25), .9, .95, .975, 1), 
            na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    subset(
      i, 
      subset = 
        nFeature_RNA > stats_qc["10%", "nFeature_RNA"] &
        nFeature_RNA < stats_qc["90%", "nFeature_RNA"] & 
        percent_mitochondrial < stats_qc["90%", "percent_mitochondrial"] & 
        nCount_RNA < stats_qc["90%", "nCount_RNA"]
  )
  }
)

list.mapv(
  seq_along(list_seurat0),
  f(i) ~ print_filtered_cells(list_seurat0[[i]], list_seurat[[i]])
)
```

## Doublets
### DoubletFinder
```{r}
n_cores1 <- min(n_cores, length(list_seurat))

multiplet_rates_10x <- data.frame(
  multiplet_rate = c(0.004, 0.008, 0.0160, 0.023, 0.031, 0.039, 0.046, 0.054, 0.061, 0.069, 0.076),
  recovered_cells = c(500, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000, 8000, 9000, 10000)
)

list_seurat <- list.map(
    list_seurat,
    f(i) ~{
        if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
            n_cores2 <- 1
        } else {
            n_cores2 <- n_cores
        }
        doublet_finder <- paramSweep(i, PCs = seq(n_dim), sct = SCT, num.cores = n_cores2)
        
        doublet_finder_stats <- summarizeSweep(doublet_finder)
        doublet_finder_best <- find.pK(doublet_finder_stats)
        
        pK <- doublet_finder_best %>%
            filter(BCmetric == max(BCmetric)) %>%
            pull(pK) %>%
            as.character() %>%
            as.numeric()
        
        multiplet_rate <- multiplet_rates_10x %>% 
            filter(recovered_cells < nrow(i@meta.data)) %>% 
            dplyr::slice(which.max(recovered_cells)) %>%
            select(multiplet_rate) %>%
            as.character() %>%
            as.numeric()
        
        nExp <- round(multiplet_rate * nrow(i@meta.data))
        
        i <- doubletFinder(
            i,
            PCs = seq(n_dim),
            pK = pK, 
            nExp = nExp,
            sct = SCT
        )
        doublet_name <- paste(0.25, pK, nExp, sep = "_")
        i@meta.data <- i@meta.data %>% 
            rename_with(
                ~"doubletFinder", 
                all_of(paste0("DF.classifications_", doublet_name))
            ) %>%
            rename_with(
                ~"pANN", 
                all_of(paste0("pANN_", doublet_name))
            )
        
        gc()
        return(i)
    }
)
```

### scDblFinder
```{r}
seurat <- integrate_multisamples(list_seurat, cell_id)
seurat[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat[["RNA"]])

if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  bp_param <- SnowParam(workers = n_cores, type = "SOCK",  exportglobals = TRUE, progressbar = TRUE)
} else {
  bp_param <- MulticoreParam(workers = n_cores, progressbar = TRUE)
}

sce <- scDblFinder(
  GetAssayData(seurat[["RNA"]], slot = "counts"),
  samples = seurat$Patient,
  aggregateFeatures = FALSE,
  k = NULL,
  processing = "normFeatures",
  dims = 20,
  BPPARAM = bp_param
)

seurat$doublets <- sce[, row.names(seurat[[]])]$scDblFinder.class %>% str_to_sentence()
seurat$doublet_score <- sce[, row.names(seurat[[]])]$scDblFinder.score
```

## Gene filtering
```{r filter_mark}
if (isFALSE(SCT)) {
      seurat <- NormalizeData(seurat) %>%
      FindVariableFeatures()
    variable_plot(seurat)
}
```

## PCA
```{r pca}
if (!SCT) {
  if (assay == "sketch") {
    seurat <- SketchData(seurat, over.write = TRUE)
    DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "sketch"
  }
  seurat <- ScaleData(seurat)
} else {
  seurat <- SCTransform(seurat, method = "glmGamPoi", assay = "RNA")
  assay <- "SCT"
  DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "SCT"
  if (assay == "sketch") {
     seurat <- SketchData(seurat, over.write = TRUE)
    DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "sketch"
  }
}
seurat <- RunPCA(seurat, reduction_key = "Dim. ", npcs = max_dim)
```

```{r qc_sub, fig.height = 8}
(ncol(seurat) / ncol(seurat_old) * 100 - 100) %>% `*`(-1) %>% round(1) %>% paste("%")

plot_bar_kept(seurat_old, seurat, unique(seurat$Patient))
```
